extracted.subtask_description: A beginner-focused video workshop introducing the overall process of grant writing and the standard elements to include in a grant proposal. Geared toward novice grant writers and provided as a recorded community-library presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process of grant writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Viewers will learn about the process of grant writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a 44:51 workshop video; intended as an introductory overview for novices. Page provides video file and caption/transcript files (English and Spanish) but does not list step-by-step process details on the page itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elements of a proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Viewers will learn about the elements of a proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied coverage of what to include in a grant proposal (e.g., sections, required components), but the Internet Archive page only gives this high-level learning objective and links to the video and transcript files for full content.
